hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *server.bundle.js|*/setup/dist/*|*/setup/mcp-bundle/*) jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Generated artifact. Edit the source under loopback/mcp (or loopback/skills, loopback/commands) and rebuild — do not edit server.bundle.js, setup/dist/, or setup/mcp-bundle/ directly."}}';; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.bundle.js) ;; */loopback/mcp/*|*/loopback/core/*) jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:"Source under loopback/mcp or loopback/core changed — loopback/mcp/server.bundle.js (and its copy in setup/mcp-bundle) is now stale. Rebuild: (cd loopback && npm run build) then (cd setup && npm run build)."}}';; esac || true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *feedback-record.schema.json) d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; err=$(node -e 'const Ajv=require(process.argv[2]+"/loopback/node_modules/ajv/dist/2020");const af=require(process.argv[2]+"/loopback/node_modules/ajv-formats");const add=af.default||af;const fs=require("fs");try{const a=new Ajv({allErrors:true,strict:false});add(a);a.compile(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1])));}catch(e){console.error(e.message);process.exit(1)}' "$f" "$d" 2>&1) || msg="schema is invalid: $err"; diff -q "$d/service/feedback-record.schema.json" "$d/loopback/core/feedback-record.schema.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || msg="${msg:+$msg; }the two schema copies (service vs loopback/core) have drifted — re-sync them."; [ -n "$msg" ] && jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("⚠ "+$m)}}';; esac || true
